summary.headline: A strong Mitra Tara day for your career
summary.narrative: Asha, today the Moon is in your 9th house from your natal Moon, a "Low steam" kind of day, and Mitra Tara is on your side. In the background, Saturn in your 4th from Moon ("Kantaka Shani: home and peace") sets the longer-term tone. Your Rahu-Venus dasha keeps love, comfort, creativity, luxury and partnerships in focus. Your career looks strongest (84/100), while health needs a gentler touch.

taraBala.name: Mitra
taraBala.meaning: Mitra Tara: the star of friendship. Cooperation, networking and social plans go well.

dasha.theme: Your Rahu-Venus period blends ambition, foreign links, technology and sudden change with love, comfort, creativity, luxury and partnerships, activating your 11th house from Lagna (gains, friends and wishes). These energies cooperate, so steady effort tends to be rewarded; enjoy life while keeping spending and indulgence in check, helped by Venus being exalted in your chart.

transits.title: Saturn in your 4th from Moon
transits.simple: Saturn is testing your patience with your home and family life
transits.meaning: Kantaka Shani: home and peace. Saturn in the 4th from your Moon (Kantaka or Ardhashtama Shani) can bring pressure at home, property issues and inner restlessness. Stability comes from patience and simple routines.
realLife: Home may need repairs, or you may relocate.
Your mother or family elders may need care.
You may feel emotionally distant or unsettled.
Work-life balance becomes a challenge.

transits.title: Jupiter in your 8th from Moon
transits.simple: Jupiter asks you to be careful with your health and unexpected events
transits.meaning: Transformation and caution. Jupiter in the 8th from your Moon can bring hardship, unexpected expenses and health concerns. It is also a year of deep learning, research and spiritual growth.
realLife: Unexpected expenses or financial adjustments may happen.
Health may need regular check-ups.
You may feel drawn to spiritual or occult subjects.
Inheritance, insurance or joint-money matters may come up.

transits.title: Rahu in your 3rd from Moon
transits.simple: Rahu boosts ambition in your efforts, short trips and siblings
transits.meaning: Bold moves succeed. Rahu in the 3rd from your Moon is one of its best placements. Courage, media, technology and bold initiatives tend to succeed, and you can outmanoeuvre obstacles.
realLife: You feel brave enough to take calculated risks and promote yourself.
Media, writing, sales, marketing or tech projects gain traction.
Short trips and new contacts bring openings.
You find clever workarounds for problems that used to block you.
doList: Launch bold initiatives and pitch ideas

transits.title: Ketu in your 9th from Moon
transits.simple: Ketu may unsettle your luck, travel and elders
transits.meaning: Spiritual questions. Ketu in the 9th from your Moon can create distance from traditions or teachers while deepening your personal spirituality.
realLife: You may question inherited beliefs.
Pilgrimage or solitary travel attracts you.
Distance from mentors or your father is possible.
Your own spiritual path becomes clearer.

transits.title: Mars in your 8th from Moon
transits.simple: Mars may bring friction to your health and unexpected events
transits.meaning: Slow down and stay safe. Mars in the 8th from your Moon is traditionally a sensitive transit. Accidents, fevers and sudden expenses are more likely when you rush, so prioritise safety and calm.
realLife: You may feel drained or tense without a clear reason.
Rushing raises the chance of minor injuries.
Unexpected costs related to health, vehicles or loans may arise.
Hidden tensions can surface in relationships.
doList: Regular health checks if anything feels off

transits.title: Sun in your 10th from Moon
transits.simple: Sun supports your career and reputation
transits.meaning: Career in the spotlight. The Sun in the 10th from your Moon is favourable for career and status. Work gets completed, seniors notice you and leadership roles feel natural.
realLife: Your work is more visible; good moment for reviews and presentations.
Pending projects reach completion more easily.
Government or official work tends to go smoothly.
You may be offered more responsibility or a leadership task.

transits.title: Venus in your 11th from Moon
transits.simple: Venus brings joy to your income and friendships
transits.meaning: Gains and pleasures. Venus in the 11th from your Moon brings income, luxuries and pleasant social life.
realLife: Income or bonuses may come.
Friends invite you out; social life is busy.
Desires and wishes come true.

transits.title: Mercury in your 11th from Moon
transits.simple: Mercury helps with your income and friendships
transits.meaning: Good news and gains. Mercury in the 11th from your Moon brings income, comfort and helpful contacts. Trade and communication bring rewards.
realLife: Payments, orders or good news can arrive.
Friends and networks bring opportunities.
Learning pays off quickly.

transits.title: Moon in your 9th from Moon
transits.simple: Moon makes you sensitive about your luck, travel and elders
transits.meaning: Low steam. The Moon in the 9th from your natal Moon can bring fatigue and small obstacles. Move at a steady pace and keep faith that delays are temporary.
realLife: Things may take longer than planned.
Digestion or energy may feel off.
Advice from elders helps more than pushing alone.

aspects.meaning: Transit Saturn supports your natal Rahu, touching your ambitions and restlessness with Saturn’s discipline, responsibility and patience. The influence is noticeable but mild; awareness is enough.

Transit Saturn flows harmoniously with your natal Ketu, touching your intuition and detachment with Saturn’s discipline, responsibility and patience. The influence is noticeable but mild; awareness is enough.

Transit Saturn challenges your natal Jupiter, touching your luck, wisdom and growth with Saturn’s discipline, responsibility and patience. Expect some pressure here; patience and planning turn it into growth.

Transit Saturn merges with your natal Venus, touching your relationships, pleasures and finances with Saturn’s discipline, responsibility and patience. Expect some pressure here; patience and planning turn it into growth.

Transit Venus opposes your natal Mercury, touching your thinking, communication and business sense with Venus’s love, pleasure, beauty and comfort. The influence is noticeable but mild; awareness is enough.

Transit Mercury opposes your natal Mercury, touching your thinking, communication and business sense with Mercury’s communication, learning and trade. The influence is noticeable but mild; awareness is enough.

remedy.title: For your health: steady Mars's influence
remedy.mantra: Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah
remedy.action: Recite the Hanuman Chalisa and do twenty minutes of vigorous exercise; avoid arguments.
